title: Quiet/Luxury Townhouse on Golf Course!
description:
1,216 square feet. Spacious, quiet, safe Townhouse located on The Nashboro Golf Course. Stunning view of hole #2 along with pool and access to course. 

Guests will have the entire house to themselves. 

Close proximity to: Nashville Airport, Opryland Hotel / Opry Mills Mall, Grand Ole Opry, and 20 mins to Downtown.. This location can accommodate business travelers as well as couples or individuals looking for a home away from home while in Nashville!

1 mile from Kroger and restaurants.

The space
The neighborhood pool is OPEN from early May until late September. 

There is an air twin mattress with a built in pump that inflates in 1 minute for the 5th guest if needed. 

10 minutes to Percy Priest Lake.

10 mins to the Airport.

20-23 mins to downtown Nashville and Music Row.  I recommend Lyft or Uber because parking is expensive downtown.

Some of my favorites restaurants are:  Sinema, ACME, Husk, Rolf and Daughters, Five Points Pizza, Hattie B's Chicken, Valentino's, 5th and Taylor, The Yellow Porch, and The Pharmacy.  

30 minutes to historic Franklin, TN.

24 hour video surveillance outside for guests’ security.

Guest access
Guests have access to the pool. 

The pool is a 3-4  minute walk from the townhouse.  

Extra precautions in place for COVID 19 cleaning.

Other things to note
Amazon Echo is downstairs.  

The TVs have access to Netflix and Amazon Prime.  High Speed internet too.
